rule: Append-only. A (key, fetched_utc) pair already present is never rewritten, reordered or dropped, so a re-run adds zero rows and a changed upstream value is refused rather than overwriting the observation as it stood. generated_utc is the last APPEND, not the last run: a run that appends nothing leaves this file byte-identical.
source: scripts/archive_weather_forecast.py over data/weather_forecast.json `games` (Open-Meteo forecast rows only; climatology rows never enter)
